detail.longDescription: In my workflow, I frequently update one repo with: git fetch git merge --ff-only For the first time git reported: Updating d44644d0d..10d30dd3b Updating files: 100% (971/971), done. error: packfile .git/objects/pack/pack-94d4846b9932b2718c2643bcb9e174c964614cb8.pack index unavailable error: packfile .git/objects/pack/pack-94d4846b9932b2718c2643bcb9e174c964614cb8.pack index unavailable error: packfile .git/objects/pack/pack-94d4846b9932b2718c2643bcb9e174c964614cb8.pack index unavailable error: packfile .git/objects/pack/pack-94d4846b9932b2718c2643bcb9e174c964614cb8.pack index unavailable Fast-forward somedir/some_file.sql | Bin 0 -> 2961389 bytes ... ... anotherdir/another_file.php | 5 +- 966 files changed, 25892 insertions(+), 6475 deletions(-) What is the problem git reports? How do I handle the error regarding "index unavailable"?
